effect_preregistration.primary_comparison: C73-s130585 minus C73-s30195 under the same fresh 130585-step schedule
effect_preregistration.offline_gate: No physical-action, gripper macro-F1, visual shuffle sensitivity or wrong-language sensitivity regression beyond the fixed C69 safety tolerance; at least one preregistered action metric must improve without conditioning collapse.
effect_preregistration.promotion_comparison: If the internal gate passes, compare the selected fixed C73 endpoint directly against promoted C69-s20000 using fresh paired LIBERO initial states and the unchanged evaluator.
stop_conditions: Any NaN/nonfinite gradient, restore mismatch, source/data hash drift or action-contract drift.
Conditioning-collapse gate fails at the internal s30195 or s130585 endpoint.
After completed s130585 evaluation, the internal learning curve is saturated or worse; do not extend merely because more steps are available.

decision.rationale: The real eight-rank C73 canary passed finite-gradient, all-30-block, zero-leak and exact-restore gates. GO_LONG permits the fixed 130585-step trajectory, but the current server deadline is expected to leave it partial; only completed strict-restored milestones may be retained and no partial endpoint establishes three-epoch effectiveness.
